fee_notes: Royalty is 4.5% for first and second stores, 2.25% for third and subsequent stores. Local advertising is 5% of Gross Revenues monthly (paid to third parties). National Advertising Fund currently 0.5% (up to 2%). Accounting fee $525/month. POS user maintenance $129/month payable to POS provider.
